subject: ela
intro: Fourth graders use technology to produce and publish writing, including typing at least a page in a single sitting, and to interact and collaborate with others. Tools include keyboards, spell-checkers, saving, printing, and sharing online. Knowing keyboarding skills makes writing faster.

items.prompt: What skill lets you type words quickly on a computer?
What tool underlines words that might be spelled wrong?

steps: A spell-checker flags possible spelling mistakes.
So the tool is the spell-checker.

items.prompt: To work on a report WITH a classmate at the same time online, you ____ the document.

steps: Sharing lets you collaborate on the same document.

items.prompt: To avoid losing your work, you should ____ it.
To make a paper copy, you ____ it.
Typing quickly and correctly is called ____.
